relation.note: Sūdūn was a mamlūk (freedman/client) of the Mamluk amir Nawrūz al-Ḥāfiẓī.
Appointed him as amīr during his reign.

event.desc: Appointed as an amīr during the reign of Sultan al-Ẓāhir Jaqmaq.
event.note: During the reign of Sultan al-Ẓāhir Jaqmaq (r. 842–857 AH).

person.note: スードゥン・アン＝ナウルーズィー（ナウルーズ・アル＝ハーフィズィーの配下、シャーム副王）。スードゥン・アル＝アジャミーとしても知られる。十人長（アミール・アシャラ）および近衛隊長（ラアス・ナウバ）の一人。ザーヒル・ジャクマクの治世にアミール（諸公）に列せられた。850年頃に没した。一説には、彼は凡庸な（あるいは怠惰な）人物であったと言われている。

Sūdūn al-Nawrūzī, the mamlūk of Nawrūz al-Ḥāfiẓī and vice-roy of Syria. He was known as Sūdūn al-ʿAjamī. He was one of the amīrs of ten and heads of the guard (raʾs nawba). He was promoted to the rank of amīr during the reign of al-Ẓāhir Jaqmaq. He died around 850 AH, and it was said that he was of little consequence.
